basic_profile.bio: Originally from the coastal town of Bar Harbor, Maine, NauticalNovice123 is a 29-year-old marine biologist who recently discovered the world of Reddit. They have a passion for all things related to the sea, from boating to marine ecosystems, and spend their days working at a local aquarium. In their free time, they delve into fantasy worlds through series like JumpChain and The Midnight Gospel. They are single and enjoy exploring new hobbies like creative writing and attending online discussion forums. Their typical online hours are in the evenings after work, usually between 7 PM and 11 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Marine Biology from the University of Maine, NauticalNovice123 has a strong foundation in aquatic sciences. They have expanded their knowledge through self-taught courses in creative writing and fiction storytelling, which is evident in their engagement with fantasy and speculative fiction subreddits.
